description: Paper speed trader requested by the user: many short trades on 20 liquid stocks, with Jev (TypeSafe System One) as the only entry decision-maker and fixed exits. Each completed 1-minute bar, a cheap prefilter picks momentum/volume candidates and Jev returns the probability that price reaches +0.30% before -0.25% within 8 minutes; entries need p >= 0.65 and fill two bars later. No rule-based fallback: without Jev the book does not trade. Proceeds are reusable immediately (a real account under $25,000 could not do this: pattern-day-trader rule), so the result cannot transfer to real money. Costs are the realistic floor for mega-caps (about 3 bp per side entry, 3 bp exit, 5 bp stops), far below the day trader's. Break-even needs roughly a 58% hit rate. Expect it to lose if Jev has no edge; every Jev probability is logged to state/speed_calls.jsonl for a calibration check. No profit claim.

universe.note: all average more than $1 billion traded per day, which is why the mega-cap cost tier is used

risk.note: Disaster brake; the per-day loss limit and fixed exits are the working controls.
